description: An AI Concierge replaces static business feedback and lead-qualification forms with adaptive conversations that understand context, capture structured responses, and trigger the right next step. With Perspective, your AI assistant can design conversation agents (Concierge, Interviewer, Evaluator, Advocate), invite participants, analyze responses with trust scoring, and wire automations to Slack, HubSpot, Gmail, or webhooks.
